title: VPC post-upgrade kickstart checks: API readiness, model-load benchmarks, smoke harness
creator: Liam Chen
description: Background: After automated upgrades to Private (VPC) clusters we need a fast, reliable post-upgrade 'kickstart' that programmatically verifies API readiness, model load behavior, and a lightweight smoke harness before handing environments back to customers. This ticket designs and implements the kickstart suite (scripts + Terraform outputs + runbook) used by CI/CD and on-call.
acceptance_criteria: API readiness probe: /health and /ready endpoints return 200 within 3s for control plane and per-model inference worker endpoints
Model load benchmark: load a representative 7B and 70B model variant, verify cold-start median latency < 7s (7B) and < 40s (70B) and hot-start p50 response < 300ms for 7B, < 1s for 70B
Smoke inference: run 50 single-token generation requests across two model families, assert no 5xx errors and <2% error rate
KV cache warmup: ensure KV cache hit rate increases by >30% after prefix warmup script
Roll forward criteria: if all probes pass, mark upgrade as success and trigger final telemetry collection; failures must create an incident and trigger automated rollback candidate flag
Artefacts: scripts checked in at github.com/redwood-inference/private-sanity/harness, Terraform outputs documented in Confluence and a runbook added to oncall playbook
comments: 2026-03-11 - Liam Chen: Kickoff meeting. Goal is a 10-minute automated smoke sequence that can be run by CI after terraform apply. Initial scope: API checks, simple model-loads, KV warmup, and basic metrics export.

2026-03-12 - Ava Martinez: PoC model-load benchmark implemented in model-load-bench.py. Tracks cold-start and steady-state latency, stores results to /tmp/kickstart-results.json and pushes to the temporary S3 bucket for debugging. Link to PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/private-sanity/pull/162

2026-03-13 - SRE (Priya Rao): Reviewed thresholds. Recommended raising 70B cold-start threshold to 40s and adding a fail-open flag for non-critical customers. Also requested a clear rollback criterion when p50 exceeds baseline by >2x.

2026-03-14 - Ava Martinez: Integrated Terraform outputs - public_api_url, cluster_region, instance_group_ids - into harness. Added exponential backoff for API probes and made KV warmup idempotent. Running a full upgrade test on staging now.
